items.raw_excerpt: Keralam Senior Citizens Bill 2026 aims to protect elderly rights, promote active ageing, regulate care centres, and empower caregivers.
items.summary_en: A new bill in Kerala wants to protect the rights and dignity of older people. It plans to guide care centres and support those who look after the elderly.
items.summary_ko: 인도 케랄라주가 어르신의 권리와 존엄을 지키는 새 법안을 발의했습니다. 이 법안은 노인 돌봄 시설을 관리하고, 돌봄 종사자들을 지원하는 내용을 담고 있습니다.
items.title_en: New Kerala Bill Focuses on Care and Rights of Elderly People
items.title_ko: 케랄라주, 어르신 권리와 존엄 보호 담은 새 법안 발의
items.title_original: Keralam Senior Citizens (Care and Protection) Bill to focus on protection of rights, dignity of elderly

items.raw_excerpt: CNN Portugal generó confusión en diversos portales tras republicar la conversación como si fuese actual.
items.summary_en: CNN Portugal republished an old Cristiano Ronaldo interview as if it were new. The repost caused confusion across many news sites. The interview was later deleted.
items.summary_ko: CNN 포르투갈이 크리스티아누 호날두의 옛 인터뷰를 최신 것처럼 다시 게시했다. 이 때문에 여러 매체에서 혼란이 빚어졌고, 해당 인터뷰는 결국 삭제됐다.
items.title_en: I am the best in history: Old Ronaldo interview deleted after it reappeared online

items.raw_excerpt: We've found the top Tassie spots for your next adventure, from quaint seaside towns to lively historic hubs.
items.summary_en: Australian Traveller picked the top towns in Tasmania for a trip. The list includes quiet seaside towns and lively historic hubs. It is a travel guide for your next adventure.

items.raw_excerpt: Wellington's deputy mayor is warning it could cost every ratepaying household or business more than $80,000 over the next 25 years to fix the city's poor pipes alone.
items.summary_en: Wellington's deputy mayor says fixing the city's poor pipes could cost each ratepaying household or business more than $80,000 over the next 25 years. The warning highlights the huge price of repairing aging underground infrastructure.
items.summary_ko: 웰링턴 부시장이 시의 낡은 수도관을 수리하는 데 향후 25년간 세금을 내는 가구나 사업체당 8만 달러 이상이 들 수 있다고 경고했다. 이번 경고는 노후 지하 인프라를 고치는 비용이 얼마나 큰지를 보여준다.
items.title_en: Wellington pipe fixes could cost each household over $80,000

items.title_original: Deputy mayor puts price of fixing Wellington's pipes at $80k per ratepayer over 25 years

items.raw_excerpt: It’s been just a week since the Reykjavík International Film Festival wrapped up, and there’s already another film event on the horizon. A special pop-up programme at Bíó Paradís celebrates the Nordic Council Film Prize, showcasing some of the award-winning films. But cinema isn’t the only thing making this week special. Live music, creative workshops…
items.summary_en: A pop-up film programme at Bíó Paradís is showing Nordic Council Film Prize winners. The week also brings live music, creative workshops, and more. The Reykjavik International Film Festival ended just last week.
items.summary_ko: 레이캬비크의 비오 파라디스에서 북유럽 영화상을 받은 작품을 모은 팝업 영화제가 열린다. 이번 주에는 라이브 음악과 창작 워크숍도 함께 열린다. 레이캬비크 국제 영화제가 끝난 지 겨우 일주일 만이다.
items.title_en: Pop-up Film Festival and Live Music in Reykjavik This Week

items.raw_excerpt: Portuguese institutions have improved their positions in the Financial Times 2026 Executive MBA ranking, with Iscte leading nationally and Porto Business School making significant progress.
items.summary_en: Portuguese institutions improved their positions in the Financial Times 2026 Executive MBA ranking. Iscte now leads in Portugal, and Porto Business School made significant progress.

items.raw_excerpt: LDF walks out of Kerala Assembly over police action at University Hostel; debate, baton dispute, and protest violence highlighted.
items.summary_en: Opposition lawmakers walked out of the Kerala state assembly. They protested police action at a university hostel. The session saw a debate, a baton dispute, and protest violence.
items.summary_ko: 야당 연합 LDF가 대학 기숙사에 대한 경찰 대응에 항의해 Kerala 주 의회 회의를 중단하고 나왔다. 회의장에서는 격렬한 토론과 곤봉 사용 논란, 시위 폭력 문제가 쟁점이 되었다.
items.title_en: Lawmakers walk out of Kerala Assembly over police action at university hostel
